title: Judging the Judges: A Systematic Study of Position Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of candidate solutions in prompts during pairwise and list-wise comparisons to measure how frequently the LLM judge favors a specific position (primacy or recency) rather than objectively evaluating the content, using metrics like Position Consistency and Preference Fairness.
